newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Drillsearch gets Albanian project approval.
newsitem.headline: Drillsearch gets Albanian project approval.

text.p: Oil explorer Drillsearch Energy NL said on Friday it had recieved approval from the Albanian government for the redevelopment of the Ballsh-Hekal and Cakran-Mollaj Oil Fields in Southern Albania.

Drillsearch said it had received official signed documents from the Albanian Council of Ministers approving the Petroleum Agreement. It said preparations were now being made to take control of the fields in early July, 1997.
It said the Ballsh-Hekal field has estimated proven reserves of up to 400 million barrels of oil and the Cakran-Mollaj has proven oil reserves of about 300 million barrels.
Drillsearch has a 47.5 percent interest in the Petroleum agreement, Kiwi International Ltd also has 47.5 percent. Kitari Oil Pty Ltd is the operator and has a five percent stake.
